figurative_meaning_en: To become ignorant of what is beneficial or harmful
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে নিজের ভালোমন্দ বুঝতে অন্ধ হয়ে গেছে।
এই সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ায় তুমি সম্পূর্ণ অন্ধ হয়ে পড়েছ।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become blind to his own good and bad.
In making this decision, you have completely become blind to the consequences.
note: This idiom uses the metaphor of physical blindness to denote mental or perceptual ignorance, common in Bengali proverbial language.
